messages:
incident-bot: SEV2 alert: elevated 5xx rate from console API /v1/console/metrics across multiple regions. Affected customers: some Dedicated & Hosted. Paging oncall: @Ashley. Initial spike at ~1880001200. 

Ashley: On it. Jumping on bridge. Can someone attach the most recent deploys/flags? :phone:

Samir: Noted — no deploys in last 30m from infra. Last config push to control-plane was @1879999000 (feature flags).

Jia: Seeing telemetry that dataplane error rate is flat for inference endpoints; spike isolated to console API routes that hit control-plane config lookups. Possibly flag propagation?

Kyle: Checking routing tables + proxy. Control plane health shows 200 for /flags, but console returns 503. Possible cache miss cascade.

Maria: Support seeing customer reports: "console shows model not found" then 503s. Only occurs when opening routing tab.

Ashley: Hypothesis 1: config propagation lag — console trying to read new flag schema, control plane returning unexpected payload -> stacktrace in console service -> returns 503. Hypothesis 2: KV cache eviction on dataplane causing requests to fail downstream. We'll collect logs.

Samir: Pulling control-plane logs for /flags/resolve. Filter: env=prod service=control-plane route=/flags/resolve status!=200 since 1879998000.

Samir: Log snippet: ```
[1880001187] WARN resolver: schema mismatch for customer=acme-corp key=console_feature_v2
[1880001187] ERROR http: panic serving /flags/resolve: json.Unmarshal: unknown field \"rollout_policy\"
(stacktrace)
```

Ashley: That ERROR is promising for hypothesis 1. Who pushed the schema change? @Samir any recent PRs?

Samir: We merged #4123 two hours ago to support rollout_policy. But the control-plane deploy included a decoder update; looks like one replica still running old binary? Investigating.

Jia: From dataplane metrics: console frontends are getting 200s from control-plane for most customers but some requests get 500 from the console service. Might be a mixed-version binary race.

Kyle: Checking cluster: control-plane has 4 replicas. One shows older image tag 2026-02-11b. Rolling update didn't finish due to a node drain failure. That explains mixed behavior.

Ashley: Live mitigation: 1) Route traffic away from the old replica via LB weight adjust. 2) Temporarily enable strict-schema compatibility flag on console to fallback to older field names. Which is faster?

Samir: I can LB-drain the node. Command: ```kubectl cordon node-az2-03 && kubectl drain node-az2-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data``` Doing it now.

pagerduty: @Ashley acknowledged the page. Estimated response SLA updated.

Maria: Notifying affected customers: posting a status note with current mitigation steps and ETA for full fix. Draft: "We've identified a schema mismatch between control plane replicas causing intermittent 503s in console. We're draining the old replica and will post an update in 15 minutes." Want approval.

Ashley: Approve. Add note that no inference requests were impacted.

Samir: Drain started. Logs show connection termination then health checks fail on old replica. Health checks rebalanced.

Jia: After drain starts, error rate decreased by ~70% within 90s. 

Kyle: Confirming: post-drain, all control-plane replicas are on 2026-03-01b (decoder includes rollout_policy). No more json.Unmarshal panics in logs.

Ashley: Mitigation successful. Now post-incident actions: build a safer decoder that ignores unknown fields, and add rollout_policy feature gate so schema additions are opt-in until all replicas updated. Also add a preflight that rejects mixed-version rollouts.

Samir: I'll open a changelist for the tolerant decoder + add a CI check for image rollouts across AZs.

Jia: For RCA notes: timeline snippet to include — initial spike 1880001187, panic logs at 1880001187, drain started 1880001302, error rate normalized 1880001395.

Ashley: Assigning owners: Samir = config decoder fix + rollout check, Jia = postmortem timeline + metrics graphs, Kyle = LB automation so node drains don't leave old replicas. Maria = customer comms and postmortem blurb.

Maria: I'll post the status update now and create the customer notes thread.

Samir: PR #4210 created for decoder fix — rough patch to ignore unknown fields. Will send for review.

Ashley: Thanks team. Leaving a short handoff: I need to go offline in 20m — @Kyle, you'll take on-call bridge if anything else bubbles. Handoff at 1880002500.

Kyle: Confirmed. I'll monitor logs and the health dashboard for the next 2 hours.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity downgraded to SEV3 at 1880001450. Root cause: mixed-version control-plane replicas; schema change introduced new field rollout_policy causing decoder panic in older binary -> 503s on console API. Mitigation: drained old replica, LB rebalance. Postmortem tracking: https://internal.redwood/pm/1880001234 (placeholder). :white_check_mark:
